item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Illinois player wins largest Powerball lottery jackpot of the year
item.description: An Illinois ticket won the $1.04 billion Powerball jackpot Wednesday, ending a 32-drawing streak without a winner and resetting the prize to $20 million.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Area code history highlights Tampa identity during 813 Day celebrations
item.description: On August 13, Tampa businesses are serving up $8.13 specials, residents are wearing 813 shirts and local landmarks are leaning into the city’s best-known three numbers.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tropical Depression Cristobal expected to dissipate Thursday
item.description: FOX 13 meteorologists are monitoring three tropical weather systems moving through the Atlantic basin, though none pose an immediate threat to the United States.
